idea-plugin.name: ReLang
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for ReLang, a resumable programming language built on GraalVM Truffle.

Features

  • Syntax highlighting for .re files (via TextMate grammar)
  • File type recognition

Optional: LSP Support

For code completion and go-to-definition, install the LSP4IJ plugin and configure it to connect to localhost:8123. Then run your ReLang program with --experimental-options --lsp.
